justifications.clinical.efficiency: ASHA BCS-CL portfolio plus exam; significant documentation requirements.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to SLPs specializing in child language disorders; broad within pediatric SLP settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No BCS-CL billing premium; standard SLP billing applies for child language services.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited employer recognition; ASHA BCS credentials have low market differentiation.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Families may prefer credentialed language specialists.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Parents pay cash for pediatric language services, especially when schools/insurance fall short.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: BCS-CL signals expertise to parents and supports premium hourly rates in private practice.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Few SLPs hold ASHA board specialties; clear differentiator in a crowded peds-SLP market.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Can anchor a peds-language practice; other SLPs can deliver under the brand even without the cert.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Parents recognize 'specialist' but not the specific BCS-CL credential by name.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires substantial mentorship hours, portfolio, and fees; not a quick credential.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ASHA Board Certified Specialist is highly valued in CSD faculty hiring and tenure files.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Holders typically active in DLD/language-disorder research communities.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly maps to core pediatric language coursework in MS-SLP programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong evidence base in child language intervention (DLD, narrative, vocabulary).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Preferred for peds-language faculty lines; not universally required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Multi-year process; heavy lift relative to a generalist CCC-SLP hire.
